status_definitions.PLANNED: Accepted backlog concept; dependencies or scope still need review.
status_definitions.READY: Bounded scope and local implementation approach defined; not implemented.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: Specific prerequisite prevents progress; explain it in notes.
status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED: Source exists but required tests have not passed.
status_definitions.TESTED: Required scoped tests passed; publication unverified.
status_definitions.RELEASED: Source, scoped behavior and publication checked with dated evidence.
status_definitions.DEPRECATED: Retained record for a retired tool.
